description.text: The eighth expansion of the Scarlet & Violet series, released on 18 October 2024. Pikachu ex of the Stellar Tera Type leads it, the first time since the 25th Anniversary Collection that Pikachu was the face of a pack. Milotic ex, whose Ability shields it from the damage and effects of attacks by Tera Pokémon, Hydreigon ex and Tatsugiri ex of the Stellar Tera Type, Slaking ex, Scovillain ex and Durant ex join it, with Blueberry Academy's director Cyrano as a Supporter for the first time, Jasmine's Gaze, Clemont's Quick Wit, Technical Machine: Fluorite, whose attack needs Energy of three different types, and the ACE SPEC cards Scramble Switch, Miracle Headset and Amulet of Hope. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 106, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and Ultra Rare Pikachu ex, Night Stretcher and Gravity Mountain. In English most of its cards came out in Surging Sparks in November 2024.
